angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 834,840 km at 855.10 pc = 0.01 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 1.1695 +/- 0.0112 mas (same row, RUWE 1.00): 855.10 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.2 +/- 0.1 solar radii from Cabrera et al. 2014, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of KOI-351 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014ApJ...781...18C/abstract): 834,840 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.2 +/- 0.1 solar masses from Cabrera et al. 2014, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of KOI-351 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014ApJ...781...18C/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6080 +/- 260 K from Cabrera et al. 2014, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of KOI-351 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014ApJ...781...18C/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Cabrera et al. 2014, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of KOI-351 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014ApJ...781...18C/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/kepler-90.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.359, rounded to two decimals
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, Kepler-90: main object type EB*, Eclipsing Binary
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of KOI-351 (pscomppars): [M/H] 0.083 dex, from Gajdoš et al. 2019 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019RAA....19...41G/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of KOI-351 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.26853, from Gajdoš et al. 2019 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019RAA....19...41G/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of KOI-351 (pscomppars): age 0.53 Gyr, from Q1-Q8 KOI Table (https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/docs/Kepler_KOI_docs.html)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of KOI-351 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 4.6 km/s, from Liang et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161..202L/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
